# 6A. BCPack tables

*Part of the [SixNG format specification](README.md). Companion to [6. BCPack](06-bcpack.md). The values in 6A.1–6A.3 come from published third-party work; see [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES](../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md). The tables in 6A.4 were fitted for this specification.*

The same values are in [`data/bcpack-tables.json`](data/bcpack-tables.json).

## 6A.1 Static rANS models

(Confirmed: copied values; for every model the symbols tile cumulative values 1–65535 with no gap or overlap, and with these models every lane of all 108,605 chunks ends in a legal state.)

A model is chosen by the fragment header: eab (alphabet of eab + 1 bits) and q (0–15), see [§6.1](06-bcpack.md#entropy-decoder-in-full). Segment 0 is symbol 0; segment k ≥ 1 is symbols [2^(k−1), 2^k). Each cell is `base/freq` for one segment. For symbol s in a segment with first symbol s0:

```text
freq(s) = freq
cum(s)  = (base + freq * (s - s0)) mod 65536
if cum(s) == 0: freq(s) = freq - 1, cum(s) = 1     # cumulative value 0 is reserved
```

The probability scale is 65536; because value 0 is reserved, each model's frequencies sum to 65535.

## 6A.2 BC1 preset slots

(Fitted against neighbouring mips by their author, not extracted; see [BC1 blocks](06-bcpack.md#bc1-blocks-codec-0x04).) Each slot is `R0 G0 B0 R1 G1 B1` (5, 6, 5, 5, 6, 5 bits). Slots 0 and 4 are never referenced and have no value (`-`). Slots marked `*` (3, 27, 28, 33, 69, 80, 81, 102, 115, 117, 125, 127, 140, 142, 160, 165, 166, 192, 197 and 222) were refitted for this specification on 2026-11-24 (revised the same day after a per-texture recount) and replace the third-party values; see the three-colour index check in [BC1 blocks](06-bcpack.md#bc1-blocks-codec-0x04) (medium). ## 6A.4 Fitted BC3–BC7 tables

(2026-11-23, BC3, BC4, BC5 and BC7 revised 2026-11-24 with the exact rules of [§6.2](06-bcpack.md#62-bc3-blocks-codec-0x0c), [§6.3](06-bcpack.md#63-bc7-blocks-codec-0x1c) and [§6.4](06-bcpack.md#64-bc4-and-bc5-blocks-codecs-0x10-0x14), BC6H refitted 2026-11-24 without the lighting store; fitted for this specification against neighbouring mips of retail textures, not extracted; tables medium to medium-low, BC3 least reliable; see [§6.7](06-bcpack.md#67-open-unknowns) for the fit and its accuracy.) A block i with back distance d > i reads preset slot (i − d) mod 256. `-` = a slot no chunk reads, so it has no value. All values are also in [`data/bcpack-fitted-tables.json`](data/bcpack-fitted-tables.json), with a layout line per table.

Best-determined entries: the BC6H index presets at pixels 0, 2, 8 and 15 (on the 2026-11-23 fit, 720 of the 992 slot / pixel entries read as anchors are pinned to one value by the anchor rule; the 2026-11-24 BC6H refit changed 7 index slots and was not re-counted) and the BC7 index presets (1,166 of 2,942 anchor-read entries pinned). Endpoint presets have no exact check except BC6H no-wrap and BC7 mode 1 p-bit agreement.
